label: Artificial intelligence
definition: The development, use, regulation or oversight of artificial intelligence systems, including alignment with EU rules on artificial intelligence.
material_examples: Adopting rules on high-risk AI systems; designating an AI supervisory authority
incidental_examples: A general reference to new technologies in a strategy title

label: Digital government and digital public services
definition: Electronic administration and public services delivered or managed digitally, including e-government portals and online procedures.
material_examples: Making social security entitlements available through an online service
incidental_examples: Asking a ministry to publish a report on its website

label: Digital infrastructure and connectivity
definition: Broadband, mobile and other electronic communications networks, and access to them.
material_examples: Rolling out broadband to rural areas; allocating 5G spectrum
incidental_examples: Mentioning internet access in a description of living conditions

label: Data and data governance
definition: The collection, protection, quality, sharing, reuse and governance of data, including personal data protection and open data.
material_examples: Aligning personal data protection law; setting up a register with reliable data
incidental_examples: A recommendation to improve statistics without reference to data systems or governance

label: Cybersecurity
definition: The security of networks and information systems, including incident response capacity and cybersecurity rules.
material_examples: Establishing a national computer security incident response team

label: Digital identity
definition: Electronic identification, electronic signatures and other trust services.
material_examples: Introducing a national electronic identification scheme
incidental_examples: Requiring identity documents to be checked

label: Interoperability and electronic systems
definition: The ability of information systems to exchange data, and the electronic systems used to run or connect administrative processes, including connection to EU systems.
material_examples: Connecting to an EU electronic exchange system; adopting an interoperability framework
incidental_examples: Mentioning that information is shared between institutions without reference to a system; a sector IT system (customs, plant health, fisheries) described as part of that sector's reform

label: Digitalisation of government or economic activity
definition: Moving government processes or economic activity onto digital means, including digital transformation programmes and the digitalisation of businesses.
material_examples: Digitalising company registration; a programme to digitalise small businesses
incidental_examples: A passing reference to modernisation; digital skills training not directly linked to an in-scope technology or AI recommendation
